scale_cues: Used the white square plate (roughly 26-27 cm across) as the main scale reference. Food covers roughly 60-70% of the plate surface, with the chicken pieces about the size of a palm-width each. No utensils or hands visible.
assumptions: Protein is assumed to be chicken breast; it could be pork tenderloin, which would change the FDC entry.
No dressing is clearly visible; any light oil or vinaigrette was not counted as a separate item.
Small dried cranberry bits (under 5 g) were ignored.
The pale pieces among the salad greens on the left are assumed to be shredded cabbage or cooked vegetable and are included in the salad estimate.
Weights are edible cooked or raw mass estimated from visual area and typical thickness, not measured.
